ZSA FAQ

Clear answers about Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture.

What is Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture (ZSA)?

Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture is a structured clinical acupuncture system developed by Professor Ming Qing Zhu. This educational website presents ZSA through clinical assessment, scalp treatment zones, technique, immediate functional reassessment and Dao Yin.

Who developed Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture?

Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture was developed by Professor Ming Qing Zhu. The Heritage & Lineage section documents the clinical and educational transmission represented on this website.

Who teaches on this website?

The principal faculty presented here are Dr. Ru Shan Shy and Dr. Sheng Chun Chang, direct disciples of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and international educators in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture.

Is ZSA taught as a set of scalp points?

No. The educational approach presented here emphasizes a clinical system: assessment, treatment strategy, technique, reassessment and active patient participation rather than isolated point memorization.

What is Dao Yin in ZSA education?

Dao Yin refers here to guided patient participation integrated with treatment, such as movement or task-oriented activity selected according to the clinical context.

Where is ZSA education offered?

The international education archive includes activity across Asia, Australia, Europe and North America. Individual regional pages are expanded only from verified course and historical records.
